methodologyNotes: Twelve compression recovery boot systems verified 2026-08-05 directly against manufacturer/brand sites (hyperice.com, therabody.com, air-relax.com, rapidreboot.com, fitkingshop.com, compex.com via recoveryforathletes.com, thespeedhound.com, reathlete.com, renphohealthbody.com) and corroborated via authorized retailers and review sites (recoveryforathletes.com, difbetween.com, amazon.com) where the brand site lacked full specs; two seed products were replaced with the real current products they map to (see individual provenance notes) rather than fabricated to match the seed name exactly, and mmHg/chamber-count fields are left null wherever no fetched source states a figure.

products.name: Hyperice Normatec 3 Legs

specs.chambers_zones: 5 zones of gapless compression per boot, plus ZoneBoost for extra pressure to a single zone
specs.sequence_modes: 7 adjustable compression levels; ZoneBoost targeted-zone boost
specs.power_source: Rechargeable battery, up to 3 hour battery life, 15V wall charger
specs.boot_size_range: Short (5'7" and under), Standard (5'7"-6'4"), Tall (6'4" and over)
specs.session_timer: No fixed built-in cycle length stated; brand recommends 15-20 min pre-workout or 20-60 min post-workout sessions
specs.weight_portability: 3.2 lb per boot, 4 x 4.5 x 8.5 in packed, described as TSA friendly

products.provenance: Hyperice's own Normatec 3 Legs product page confirms $899.00 price, 40-110 mmHg across 7 compression levels, 5 zones of gapless compression, Bluetooth-connected Hyperice App control, ZoneBoost technology, up to 3-hour rechargeable battery life with 15V wall charger, three size options by height, 3.2 lb boot weight, and TSA-friendly 4 x 4.5 x 8.5 in packed dimensions. No fixed single-session timer length is published; the recommended 15-20/20-60 minute ranges are the brand's own usage guidance, not a hard device limit.

products.name: Therabody JetBoots Prime (formerly RecoveryAir Prime)

specs.sequence_modes: Preset treatments plus customizable pressure levels
specs.power_source: Rechargeable battery via USB-C, up to 180 min battery life
specs.boot_size_range: Short (68-81 cm leg length), Regular (81-93 cm), Long (93 cm+)
specs.weight_portability: 6 lb (Regular), foldable design, includes drawstring travel backpack

products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: Therabody has retired the standalone "RecoveryAir Prime" product name; the compact wireless boot in the current lineup is sold as "JetBoots Prime" (therabody.com/products/jetboots-prime-regular, $549.99), confirmed directly on Therabody's own site with 25-100 mmHg pressure in 25 mmHg steps, 4 overlapping air chambers, USB-C rechargeable battery (180 min), three leg-length sizes, 20/40/60-minute or continuous timer, built-in LCD one-touch control (no companion app), and 6 lb weight with a travel backpack. A third-party comparison page (recoveryforathletes.com) still lists the legacy $599 "RecoveryAir Prime" name/price, but Therabody's own current site is treated as authoritative.

Confirmed directly on Therabody's own product page: 20-100 mmHg in 5 mmHg steps, 8 sports-scientist-designed presets, AC adapter plus 150-240 min battery runtime, three leg-length sizes, 10-60 minute adjustable timer, built-in LCD one-touch control (no separate app), and 11.3-12.8 lb weight by size. No verifiable manufacturer-hosted image URL could be extracted from this page within available access, so the image field is omitted rather than guessed.

No app control is mentioned on either source. No verifiable directly-hosted product image could be retrieved within available access, so the image field is omitted.

products.name: RENPHO Leg Massager, Air Compression Massager for Circulation & Pain Relief (FSA/HSA Eligible)
products.priceNote: Current price on renphohealthbody.com (was $99.99); same listing sold on Amazon under the identical product title

specs.sequence_modes: 2 modes (Combine: cycles feet-to-thigh; Separate: targets individual sections), 4 massage intensities

products.provenance: RENPHO's entry-level air-compression leg massager (renphohealthbody.com, an authorized RENPHO reseller storefront) lists at $59.99 (from $99.99), with 3 wrap zones (feet/calf/thigh), Combine and Separate massage modes, 4 intensity levels, plug-in operation, and 3.53 lb / 15.75x6.69x7.87 in dimensions. No mmHg pressure figure or session timer is published by RENPHO for this consumer-grade device, so both are left null rather than estimated. This is distinct from RENPHO's newer premium "Aeria Boot" line (renpho.com), which the brand markets separately at a higher price point with a 50-200 mmHg spec; the seed "RENPHO Leg Massager" name matches this entry-level product's exact listed title, so it was kept as the primary entry.

products.name: FIT KING Recovery Power Pro Massage Boots (FT-091A)

specs.chambers_zones: 4 zone controllers with overlapped airbags, 360° wrap coverage
specs.power_source: Rechargeable battery, 2500 mAh, 3-4 hours per charge
specs.weight_portability: Includes portable storage bag; handheld smart controller with LCD display

products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: no product with model number "FT-054" exists in FIT KING's current or archived catalog (confirmed by enumerating FIT KING's full leg-massager model list on fitkingshop.com, which runs FT-009A through FT-130A with no FT-054 entry). The seed was replaced with FIT KING's closest full leg compression-boot equivalent, the FT-091A Recovery Power Pro Massage Boots ($449.99), confirmed directly on FIT King's official shop: 40-150 mmHg across 12 intensity levels, 4 overlapping zone airbags, 3 massage modes, a 2500 mAh battery (3-4 hr runtime), S/M/L sizing, and a 10-step 15-60 minute timer.

Up to 120 mmHg, up to 3-hour battery life, and up to 60-minute sessions were confirmed on recoveryforathletes.com, a US-authorized Compex dealer reproducing the manufacturer spec sheet, which also supplies the $599.99 US list price used here in place of the EUR figure.

No verifiable directly-hosted product image could be retrieved within available access, so the image field is omitted.

products.name: QUINEAR Professional Leg Recovery System, Cordless Air Compression Boots
products.priceNote: Price per difbetween.com product review, corroborated by the matching Amazon listing (ASIN B0CQRD2DYW)

specs.chambers_zones: 4 chambers (foot, lower calf, upper calf, thigh) with individual zone control
specs.power_source: Rechargeable battery, 2500 mAh, cordless, 2-4 hours per charge
specs.boot_size_range: One size (Large listed on Amazon SKU), adjustable

products.provenance: QUINEAR does not operate a direct brand storefront with a full spec page; the most detailed verifiable spec sheet (40-150 mmHg over 12 intensity levels, 4 individually-controlled chambers, Sequence/Circulation/Combination modes, 2500 mAh cordless battery at 2-4 hr runtime, and a 15-60 minute timer in 5-minute steps) was found on difbetween.com's product review, matching the Amazon listing title and ASIN B0CQRD2DYW used for corroboration. This cordless $499.99 model is distinct from QUINEAR's cheaper plug-in "Leg Massager with Heat" line (~$210-270, 50-120 mmHg, no cordless battery) sold on Target; the seed's generic "QUINEAR Air" name was mapped to the higher-spec cordless recovery system as the closer match to this product category. No verifiable directly-hosted product image could be retrieved within available access, so the image field is omitted.
